method.name: milp_meal_fiber
steps: Define binary variables for protein selection (y_salmon, y_beef, y_pork) and vegetable selection (y_okra, y_carrots, y_celery, y_cabbage).
Define continuous variables for vegetable amounts (in 100g units, 0-6 range).
Constraints: budget<=15, weight=6 (600g), exactly one protein, at least 2 vegetables, amount<=6*binary for each vegetable.
